title: Scenes: slope inputs that add the robot's tilt to its femur and tibia angle inputs
summary: slope_inputs 'femurs' (the former 'joints') adds the robot's tilt from its front and rear toes to each femur angle input; 'joints' now adds it to each tibia input as well, about that tibia's own axis, which lies along its femur's. With destination_v29 at 0.1 m/s on a 9.5 degree ramp, from six slightly different starts per setting, the uncorrected robot reaches the top 3 times in 6 and stalls at the foot otherwise; with the tilt added to the femurs, or to the femurs and tibias, with either sign, it reaches the top 0 times in 6, stalling within 0.4 to 0.8 m of its start. Single runs on this ramp turn on small differences in start position, so one trial per setting does not compare settings.
next: Look at foot clearance at a ramp's foot and crest before training on slopes.
reason: Scene tooling only; training, the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
